title: policy.json: precedent
description: How precedent is kept healthy (design parts 4.3 and 4.6). Changing any of it is a rule change: the owner's decision.

overrule_max.description: The largest share of a precedent's applications the owner may overrule before the precedent is put to the owner for review.

review_min_applications.description: Applications a precedent needs before its overrule share counts, so one overrule of one application does not read as 100%.

not_for_bases.description: Rule bases a precedent can never resolve: the owner decides each one afresh. Rule changes are here because a precedent that settled them would be the system granting itself autonomy (design parts 4.4 and 4.6).
